# Pasquale Caiazzo – Semantic Entity Architect

> Based in Turin, Italy. Helps professionals, SMEs, nonprofits, and B Corps become readable, citable, and accurately described by AI answer engines. Specialises in GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), semantic entity architecture, and structured data (JSON-LD / Schema.org / Wikidata).

## Who this is

Pasquale Caiazzo is a Semantic Entity Architect. He designs and implements the structured data infrastructure that allows people, companies, and organisations to be found and correctly described by AI systems — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and similar answer engines. His work sits at the intersection of knowledge graph engineering, entity disambiguation, and generative AI readiness.

VAT: IT01712990058
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/pasqualecaiazzo/
Enquiries: https://cal.com/pcaiazzo/30min

## Services

- [Semantic Identity for Professionals](https://pasqualecaiazzo.com/professionisti.html): Building verifiable digital identities for consultants, founders, authors, and researchers — so AI systems describe them accurately and without confusion with namesakes.
- [AI Readiness for SMEs](https://pasqualecaiazzo.com/pmi.html): Making brand, products, and local business presence readable and citable by answer engines. Covers entity structuring, Schema.org markup, and brand integrity.
- [AI Readiness for Nonprofits & B Corps](https://pasqualecaiazzo.com/impatto.html): Structuring mission, activities, and governance of third-sector organisations for accurate AI representation. Covers NGO markup, charity register linking, and impact data structuring.

## Manifesto

- [Digital Narrative Sovereignty](https://pasqualecaiazzo.com/manifesto.html): The founding text on why controlling one's own digital narrative matters in the age of generative AI, with references to Zuboff, Berners-Lee, and the Solid Protocol.

## Key concepts used on this site

**Entity**: A uniquely identified real-world object — person, organisation, or product — with a stable identifier and verifiable references (e.g. a Wikidata Q-ID or ORCID).

**GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)**: Structuring content and entity data so that AI answer engines cite it accurately. Distinct from SEO: GEO works at the data layer, not the content layer.

**AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)**: Optimising information architecture so queries return accurate direct answers from AI systems.

**JSON-LD**: Linked Data serialisation format used to embed machine-readable structured data in HTML pages without altering visible content.

**Schema.org**: Shared vocabulary for structured data, recognised by Google, Bing, and AI systems. Types used on this site: Person, Organization, NGO, LocalBusiness, Service, WebSite, WebPage, BlogPosting, BreadcrumbList.

**sameAs**: Schema.org property linking an entity to canonical external references — Wikidata, LinkedIn, ORCID, official registries — to enable disambiguation.

**speakable**: Schema.org property indicating which sections of a page are best suited for AI-generated audio or direct citation.

**hreflang**: HTML link element indicating language and regional targeting for multilingual pages. This site serves Italian (it) and English (en) versions of all pages.
